origin.basis: Schwalbe is the brand of Ralf Bohle GmbH, Reichshof, Germany (legal notice).

manufacturing.basis: The Schwalbe product pages do not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Schwalbe's European and North American sites give recommended retail prices and send buyers to retailers; mainland China availability not verified.

name: One Tubeless
positioning: Tubeless-easy version of the Schwalbe One all-round road tire with RaceGuard.
caveats: Schwalbe states no hookless approval on these product pages.
Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2020 test of the black 25 mm One TLE Performance is not applied to the sizes listed here.

price_observations.conditions: Recommended retail price on the official product page on 2026-11-01; one tire; retailer prices vary.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other. The black, tan and bronze sidewall versions sold on the same product pages count as the same tire.

reports.summary: Easy to set up tubeless with a track pump and great in all weathers; the owner always comes back to it.
Performing very well so far and holding pressure, though very tight on the rear rim.
Great performance, and good for winter.
Easy to fit with a track pump, with good puncture resistance so far.
Smooth and supple, and easy to fit.
Bought to replace one slashed by glass; the new one works a treat.
Every bit as good as the Pro One over nine criterium races in six days.
Rolls well and grips in variable conditions on long rides and audaxes, but wears fairly quickly.
Puncture-resistant and long-lasting (3,500 km with little wear and no flat; earlier sets lasted 9,000 and 7,000 km), but three of four tires wobble slightly.
Very hard to mount and seat, with a ride like other 28 mm tires, but really impressive grip on wet roads.
